name: Fly.io Machines
description: Run sessions on Fly.io Machines: fast-booting VMs that stop when idle.

provider.label: Fly.io Machine
provider.description: A Firecracker VM on Fly.io in the region you choose. Stops when idle and boots in seconds.

schema.label: Fly API token
schema.description: From `fly tokens create deploy` for the app below. FLY_API_TOKEN is also read.

schema.label: App name
schema.description: An existing Fly app that will hold the machines (`fly apps create`).

schema.label: Region
schema.description: e.g. iad or ams. Empty lets Fly choose.
